_meta.purpose: The video engine's product library — and, in the absence of any master Globex product list, the working master list.
_meta.coverage_note: SKELETON ONLY (2026-08-09). Seeded from the 17-image app/data/asset_pool we actually hold, which is poultry and duck. Globex also trades pork, beef, seafood and grains — those products are added later once Ilan supplies the SKU list and pack shots. Adding a product = one entry here (plus pack-shot files); no code change.
_meta.global_claims_note: Client-mandated no-say list from the June/July 2026 feedback rounds. Approved substitutions: 'shipped globally' (not '90+ countries'), 'Quality Control' (not 'inspected by hand'). Enforced in code by app/video/library.banned_terms_in().

global_visual_rules.packaging_must_be_real: Reference the actual pack shot; never let a model invent Globex packaging or labels.
